name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.28-beta “Paris” (build 27) — Word add-in fix.
• Fixes “Compile error in hidden module: LitArbiRibbon” when clicking a LitArbi button in Word. A macOS LitArbi add-in found in Word’s Startup folder is moved aside (to %LOCALAPPDATA%\LitArbi\WordAddin-disabled) and replaced with the Windows add-in; the add-in is now built so that line endings and special characters can no longer break it.
• The Word add-in is rebuilt automatically the first time LitArbi starts with Word closed.
• Everything from build 26: full parity with macOS 0.9.28 — citation pane, footnotes, Update Exhibits from Brief, List of Exhibits tables, bundles and e-briefs, Redact, searchable OCR, Mac-identical exports.
